Implemented + reviewed. regressed is derived from the Green-Head watermark in issue_state.derived_regression; issues.state is CHECKed to {unresolved,resolving,resolved,muted} and legacy regressed rows migrate on open. effective_state folds the two axes so the badge, action gate and worklist keep their existing shape. An occurrence arriving on a resolving issue no longer reopens it — the confirm verdict owns that exit.

Obsolete: the premise no longer holds. C3 needs an occurrence's build ordinal to place it against a fix's Green-Head watermark, so runs.build_run_id is now written (hook_pkg_failure sends the tracker run ordinal with the bundle) and read (the occurrence join in agentic_queries.issues). Dropping it would put the regression derivation back on wall clocks.

Implemented + reviewed. Per-key next_eligible_at on issues, exponential in the existing confirm_failure_count, honoured by issues_needing_build. Enqueue failures now go through the same budget instead of releasing the claim silently and retrying uncounted forever. Verdicts and give-up both clear the delay. Scope was cut to pacing after re-reading the code: keying and single-flight came with C1/C2, env-busy is handled by the gate stopping the loop, and A4 re-requests are successes that must not be paced.

All four children delivered. The confirm-build trigger is level-triggered intent: the tracker bumps a generation counter, the runner re-derives what needs building each pass and stays sole queue writer, regressed is derived from the build record rather than stored, and the retries are counted and paced.

Landed in aec41a4. The patch step composes the one origin before the agent
runs, after the clean check, so an attempt cannot inherit a predecessor's
discarded worktree state. A failed compose refuses the job
(patch_preflight_compose_failed, PATCH_GAVE_UP) rather than proceeding against

from turn one. Covered by tests/test_patch_preflight_compose.py.

Six variables the original audit missed, all found by the new structural
guard rather than by grep: DP_HARNESS_CONTEXT_FILE_CAP and
DPORTSV3_STALE_QUEUED_MAX_AGE_SECONDS split the call and the name across
lines; the four DP_CONFIRM_* knobs passed the name to a helper. The guard
now scans for the name itself, however it is reached, and fails the suite
on an undeclared one.

Four defects found by hardware validation, each fixed:
- deploy install migrated all four credentials at 0640, handing the
  runner's patch key to the unprivileged tracker. Modes now follow the
  reader, from one table the installer, migrate and check all read.
- install told the operator to run `config migrate`, which then refused
  because install had just written a settings file. migrate merges now;
  the installer carries the values across itself. Without that the host
  had keys but no llm.triage.model and would refuse every job.
- the tracker exited with "unable to open database file": a default
  paths.state_db was treated as "unset" and fell back to $PWD/state.db,
  and a service's cwd is /.
- retiring an operator file broke `deploy install` for anyone upgrading,
  because the installed planner demands a sample the new checkout no
  longer ships.
